entities.name: Sandis Buškevics
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sandis Buškevics is a Latvian professional basketball coach and former player. He is currently the head coach for BC Telšiai of the Nacionalinė krepšinio lyga (NKL). Buškevics was also a member of the Latvia national basketball team.
